visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An orange and white cat is seen lying comfortably on top of a black zippered shoulder bag placed on a reflective glass-topped dining table. The cat's paws are tucked neatly beneath its white chest, and its ears are alert and upright. The background shows a slightly blurred home interior with a sofa and cabinets. (2) A person's hand enters the frame from the top left and gently strokes the cat's head. The cat squint its eyes slightly in response to the petting while remaining stationary on the black bag. The indoor lighting is bright and natural, reflecting off the table surface. (3) The camera pans right to reveal an older man with glasses and grey hair sitting on a white leather sofa. He is dressed in a pale yellow polo shirt and is holding a smartphone with both hands, looking down at the screen with a slight smile. (4) The focus shifts back to the cat on the table. A hand begins tapping rhythmically on the fabric and zippers of the black bag. The cat's ears twitch, and it stares intensely at the moving fingers with a focused, somewhat annoyed facial expression. (5) The cat suddenly stands up, moving its weight off the bag and walking across the glass table. It jumps down onto the dark wooden floor and stops to look back at the camera with a disgruntled, squinted gaze before turning away. (6) The cat is finally seen lying on the wooden floor next to a dark cabinet. It rests its head on its paws while looking directly toward the camera lens with a calm but watchful expression in the well-lit room.
